messages:
Sam Chen: Quick sync — we need final copy for the three landing variants (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) + routing for webinar signups and benchmark narratives. Can we get drafts and routing plan by EOD?
Zia Patel: On it. I'll do 3 headline directions and a microcopy table.
Devon Lee: What benchmark set should we call out in hero and subheads? production p50/p95 latency and cost-per-token? Also need CTA mapping (self-serve vs sales).
Maria Gonzales: Drafting hero rows now. Roughs:
- Hosted: "Ship faster with our hosted API — per-token pricing, instant access."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput and reserved GPU pools."
- Private: "Deploy in your VPC or on-prem for compliance."
Will add 1-line value props under each.
Devon Lee: For inbound routing: one form with a hidden `product_interest` field to route leads. Example snippet for HubSpot webhook mapping:
```
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "product_interest": "hosted" // or dedicated / private
}
```
Make sure SDR queues are named `mkt-hosted`, `mkt-dedicated`, `mkt-private`.
Zia Patel: A/B test plan: Variant A highlights latency + cost (benchmarks), Variant B highlights security + compliance. Run 50/50 for 2 weeks, measure CTR -> signup -> qualified lead.
marketing-bot: staging deploy: /hero copy updated at https://staging.redwood.ai/ (build 2026.03.21-14) :rocket:
Sam Chen: Good. Also need benchmark microcopy: short line like "p50 85ms on Hosted (average), Dedicated down to 18ms in our tests" — Devon, can you verify numbers with eng-reports?
Devon Lee: Yep, I'll pull the canonical numbers and ping eng-reports. Expect confirmation by 5pm.
Maria Gonzales: CTA variants I'm drafting: "Try Hosted" (button), "Reserve Dedicated" (lead form), "Talk to Sales" (Private). Also considering a secondary CTA: "Compare performance" that triggers the benchmarks modal.
Zia Patel: Add microcopy under environment toggle: "Same API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private — pick what fits your compliance & budget." That sells the unified experience.
Sam Chen: Action items: Maria — headline + CTAs by 4pm; Devon — benchmark verification by 5pm; Zia — set up A/B in Optimizely + initial metrics; I'll draft webinar landing and the lead routing doc. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzales: Will post the draft screenshots in #marketing later today.
Devon Lee: Numbers confirmed with eng-reports. Posting final figures in thread in 15.
Zia Patel: Optimizely experiments created, targeting rules set (geo: NA/EU), will start after deploy.
Sam Chen: Perfect — thanks team.
